verdict.rationale: Trello has a REST API reference that lists sections such as Batch, Search and Webhooks. Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. Probes for an OpenAPI spec (which could drive such tooling) all returned 404, and a static reference listing alone does not meet the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
